description: The ONE business profile for the whole suite: name, address, VAT id, bank details and defaults (currency, tax rate, terms, prefix, timezone). Saved to the shared profile every other server reads. Call it once, first.

default_currency.description: ISO code, e.g. EUR, USD, JPY. Default EUR

default_tax_rate.description: Default VAT percent applied to items without their own rate

email.description: Your own email address. Leave it out unless the user gave it: no server ever fills an email from anything but this profile or an explicit argument

iban.description: IBAN or account number for payment

invoice_prefix.description: Invoice number prefix, default INV (custom prefix is Pro)

logo_path.description: Path to a PNG or JPG logo (Pro)

phone.description: Your own phone number. Same rule as email: only if the user gave it

timezone.description: IANA zone you work in, e.g. Europe/Warsaw. Shared with time-tracker (entries are stamped in it) and timezone (your home zone)

name: business_set
title: Set your business details
